At STRABAG, around 89,000 people at more than 2,400 locations worldwide are building progress. Uniqueness and individual strengths characterise not only our projects but also each and every one of us. Whether in building and civil engineering, road and underground construction, bridge and tunnel construction, in building materials production, project development or building management – we think construction further to become the most innovative and sustainable construction technology group in Europe. Equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion are integral parts of what defines us as a company and how we work.
Together we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow with new tasks. Together we create great things. Let's progress!

Construction Machinery Mechanic EFZ
Your contribution with us

• Overhauls, repairs as well as service and maintenance work on construction machinery and vehicles

• Repair assignments on construction sites with a well-equipped service vehicle

• Repair of various small devices

• General mechanical and welding work
What counts for us

• Completed apprenticeship EFZ as construction machinery / agricultural machinery or truck mechanic – recent graduates are welcome!

• Professional experience in the construction machinery / agricultural machinery sector is mandatory

• Good knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics, vehicle construction and vehicle electrics as well as welding

• Driving licence class B

• Independent, precise and reliable working method

Our added value for you
You will have the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally within the team. The framework conditions include, among other things, practice-oriented further training opportunities as well as attractive discounts for employees. Do you enjoy construction machinery and equipment, work precisely, reliably and with quality awareness, and are you open to modern technology and exciting tasks in our machinery park? Then please send us your complete and meaningful application documents stating your earliest possible starting date and salary expectations via the online form.

Kunden- / Montageschreiner:in
 Dein Beitrag bei uns

• Du stellst Dachfensterfutter nach Mass her und montierst diese fachgerecht auf der Baustelle

• Du fertigst Deckel-, Pass- und Anschlussleisten und sorgst für eine saubere und präzise Montage

• Für unseren Spezialschalungsbau stellst du besondere Holzbauteile her und bearbeitest diese unter anderem mit der Kehlmaschine

• Du erstellst Treppen nach Planvorgaben und übernimmst deren Montage auf der Baustelle

• Du führst selbstständig Kundenarbeiten, Anpassungen und individuelle Sonderlösungen aus

• Du übernimmst Finish- und Fertigstellungsarbeiten auf unseren Baustellen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Arbeiten bis ins Detail sauber abgeschlossen werden

• Bei Bedarf packst du auch bei allgemeinen Zimmermanns- und Holzbauarbeiten mit an

• Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Zimmerleuten, Bauführern und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen und findest auch bei speziellen Anforderungen eine praktische und saubere Lösung
 Was für uns zählt

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Schreiner EFZ oder eine vergleichbare handwerkliche Ausbildung

• Du bist kein reiner Werkstattschreiner, sondern arbeitest gerne praktisch und vielseitig - auch auf der Baustelle

• Zimmermanns- und Holzbauarbeiten sind für dich kein Fremdwort und du bist bereit, auch ausserhalb des klassischen Schreinerhandwerks mit anzupacken

• Du kannst Pläne lesen und Vorgaben selbstständig in die Praxis umsetzen

• Du verfügst über ein gutes handwerkliches Verständnis und findest auch bei individuellen Aufgaben und Sonderanfertigungen passende Lösungen

• Du arbeitest selbstständig, präzise und zuverlässig und hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch

• Ein professionelles Auftreten gegenüber unseren Kund und eine unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit im Team sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Ein Führerausweis der Kategorie B ist ein Muss. (Komplett ausgerüsteter Schreinerbus zur Verfügung)

• Ein Führerausweis der Kategorie BE ist von Vorteil

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab

Unser Mehrwert für dich
 Bei uns erwartet dich eine aussergewöhnlich vielseitige Tätigkeit zwischen Schreinerhandwerk, Holzbau und Spezialanfertigungen. Statt täglich die gleichen Arbeiten auszuführen, übernimmst du unterschiedlichste Aufgaben - von präzisen Detailarbeiten über Spezialbauteile und Treppen bis hin zu Montage-, Kunden- und Finisharbeiten auf unseren Baustellen.
 Du arbeitest selbstständig, kannst dein handwerkliches Können einbringen und erhältst den nötigen Freiraum, um für spezielle Aufgaben gute und praxisgerechte Lösungen zu finden.
 Wir bieten dir zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen, moderne Arbeitsmittel, abwechslungsreiche Projekte und ein kollegiales Team, in dem Schreiner und Zimmerleute eng zusammenarbeiten. Wenn du gerne vielseitig arbeitest, Holz dein Werkstoff ist und du dich nicht auf das klassische Schreinerhandwerk beschränken möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Clienti / Installazione
Il tuo contributo con noi

• Produci cornici per finestre su misura e installali professionalmente sul sito

• Produci strisce di copertura, montaggio e connessione e garantisci un'installazione pulita e precisa

• Per la nostra speciale costruzione di casseforme, si producono componenti in legno speciali e li elaborano, tra l'altro, con la macchina per scanalatura

• Si crea scale secondo le specifiche di piano e prendere sopra la loro installazione sul sito

• Realizzi in modo indipendente il lavoro del cliente, le regolazioni e le soluzioni speciali individuali

• Si prende su lavori di finitura e completamento sui nostri cantieri e assicurarsi che il nostro lavoro sia completato in modo pulito fino all'ultimo dettaglio

• Se necessario, si assiste anche con carpenteria generale e lavori di costruzione di legname

• Lavorate a stretto contatto con i nostri carpentieri, i responsabili del sito e altri dipartimenti specializzati e trovate soluzioni pratiche e pulite anche per esigenze particolari
Cosa conta per noi

• Hai completato l'addestramento come partecipante EFZ o una professione manuale comparabile

• Non sei un puro officina, ma divertiti a lavorare praticamente e variamente – anche in loco

• Lavori di costruzione di legno e carpenteria non sono stranieri per voi e siete disposti ad aiutare oltre il classico lavoro di falegnameria

• È possibile leggere i piani e implementare in modo indipendente le specifiche in pratica

• Hai una buona comprensione manuale e trovare soluzioni adatte anche per i singoli compiti e produzioni speciali

• Lavori in modo indipendente, preciso e affidabile e hai uno standard di alta qualità

• Un aspetto professionale verso i nostri clienti e lavoro di squadra semplice sono naturali per voi

• Una patente di guida di categoria B è un must. (Parcheggio completo disponibile)

• Una licenza di guida di categoria BE è un vantaggio

• Buone competenze linguistiche tedesche, sia parlate che scritte, completate il vostro profilo

Il nostro valore aggiunto per te
Con noi, ci si può aspettare un'attività eccezionalmente variata tra falegnameria, costruzione di legname e produzioni speciali. Invece di eseguire gli stessi compiti ogni giorno, si prende su una vasta gamma di compiti - da preciso lavoro di dettaglio a componenti speciali e scale per l'installazione, cliente e lavori di finitura sui nostri cantieri.
Si lavora indipendentemente, può contribuire le vostre abilità manuali e ricevere la libertà necessaria per trovare soluzioni buone e pratiche per compiti speciali.
Vi offriamo condizioni di lavoro contemporaneo, attrezzature di lavoro moderne, progetti vari e un team collegiale in cui i collaboratori e i carpentieri lavorano a stretto contatto. Se ti piace lavorare in modo diverso, il legno è il tuo materiale e non vuoi limitarti al classico falegnameria, hai esattamente ragione con noi. Non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti.

Customer / Installation Joiner
Your contribution with us

• You manufacture bespoke roof window frames and professionally install them on site

• You produce cover, fitting and connection strips and ensure clean and precise installation

• For our special formwork construction, you manufacture special wooden components and process them, among other things, with the grooving machine

• You create stairs according to plan specifications and take over their installation on site

• You independently carry out customer work, adjustments and individual special solutions

• You take on finishing and completion work on our construction sites and ensure that our work is completed cleanly down to the last detail

• If necessary, you also assist with general carpentry and timber construction work

• You work closely with our carpenters, site managers and other specialist departments and find practical and clean solutions even for special requirements
What counts for us

• You have completed training as a joiner EFZ or a comparable manual profession

• You are not a pure workshop joiner but enjoy working practically and diversely – also on site

• Carpentry and timber construction work are not foreign to you and you are willing to help out beyond classic joinery work

• You can read plans and independently implement specifications in practice

• You have a good manual understanding and find suitable solutions even for individual tasks and special productions

• You work independently, precisely and reliably and have a high quality standard

• A professional appearance towards our customers and uncomplicated teamwork are natural for you

• A category B driving licence is a must. (Fully equipped joiner van available)

• A category BE driving licence is an advantage

• Good German language skills, both spoken and written, complete your profile

Our added value for you
You can expect an exceptionally varied activity with us between joinery, timber construction and special productions. Instead of performing the same tasks daily, you take on a wide range of tasks – from precise detail work to special components and stairs to installation, customer and finishing work on our construction sites.
You work independently, can contribute your manual skills and receive the necessary freedom to find good and practical solutions for special tasks.
We offer you contemporary employment conditions, modern work equipment, varied projects and a collegial team in which joiners and carpenters work closely together. If you enjoy working diversely, wood is your material and you do not want to limit yourself to classic joinery, you are exactly right with us. We look forward to getting to know you.
